name: Production Process Activity (Web)
implementation_notes: Pure static Blade view per tech-spec — no Livewire component/controller/service/API endpoint
15 station tiles hardcoded in the view — mirrors mobile's DEFAULT_STATIONS in localSchema.ts, not a database query
Icons are small inline SVGs for the active tiles — no icon library exists yet in the backend Blade layer
